---
# Working Papers Section Module
---

```{r}
#| label: wp-setup
#| include: false

# Load working papers data if it exists
if (!exists("workingpapers") || is.null(workingpapers)) {
  workingpapers <- NULL
}
```

```{r}
#| label: wp-html
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_html

if (exists("workingpapers") && !is.null(workingpapers) && nrow(workingpapers) > 0) {
  cat('### Working Papers\n\n')
  
  # Get actual column names
  col_names <- names(workingpapers)
  
  # Sort by year if it exists, otherwise use as-is
  if ("year" %in% col_names) {
    wp_display <- workingpapers %>% arrange(desc(year))
  } else {
    wp_display <- workingpapers
  }
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(wp_display)) {
    # Extract whatever columns exist
    title_val <- if("title" %in% col_names && !is.na(wp_display$title[i])) {
      wp_display$title[i]
    } else if("article_title" %in% col_names && !is.na(wp_display$article_title[i])) {
      wp_display$article_title[i]
    } else ""
    
    authors_val <- if("authors" %in% col_names && !is.na(wp_display$authors[i])) {
      wp_display$authors[i]
    } else ""
    
    status_val <- if("status" %in% col_names && !is.na(wp_display$status[i])) {
      wp_display$status[i]
    } else ""
    
    year_val <- if("year" %in% col_names && !is.na(wp_display$year[i])) {
      as.character(wp_display$year[i])
    } else ""
    
    if (title_val != "") {
      cat(paste0('
<div class="publication-item">
<div class="pub-year">', year_val, '</div>
<div class="pub-content">
<div class="pub-title">', title_val, '</div>'))
      
      if (authors_val != "") {
        cat(paste0('<div class="pub-authors">', authors_val, '</div>'))
      }
      
      if (status_val != "") {
        cat(paste0('<div class="pub-venue"><em>', status_val, '</em></div>'))
      }
      
      cat('</div>\n</div>\n')
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: wp-pdf
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_pdf

if (exists("workingpapers") && !is.null(workingpapers) && nrow(workingpapers) > 0) {
  cat("\\vspace{0.5cm}\\hrule\\vspace{0.3cm}\n")  # Add horizontal line
  cat("\\subsection{Working Papers}\n\n")
  
  # Get actual column names
  col_names <- names(workingpapers)
  
  # Sort by year if it exists
  if ("year" %in% col_names) {
    wp_display <- workingpapers %>% arrange(desc(year))
  } else {
    wp_display <- workingpapers
  }
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(wp_display)) {
    # Extract whatever columns exist
    title_val <- if("title" %in% col_names && !is.na(wp_display$title[i])) {
      wp_display$title[i]
    } else if("article_title" %in% col_names && !is.na(wp_display$article_title[i])) {
      wp_display$article_title[i]
    } else ""
    
    authors_val <- if("authors" %in% col_names && !is.na(wp_display$authors[i])) {
      wp_display$authors[i]
    } else ""
    
    status_val <- if("status" %in% col_names && !is.na(wp_display$status[i])) {
      wp_display$status[i]
    } else ""
    
    year_val <- if("year" %in% col_names && !is.na(wp_display$year[i])) {
      as.character(wp_display$year[i])
    } else ""
    
    if (title_val != "") {
      # Title
      cat("\\textbf{", escape_latex(title_val), "}", sep = "")
      if (year_val != "") {
        cat(" (", year_val, ")", sep = "")
      }
      cat("\n\n")
      
      # Authors
      if (authors_val != "") {
        cat("\\textit{", escape_latex(authors_val), "}\n\n", sep = "")
      }
      
      # Status
      if (status_val != "") {
        cat(escape_latex(status_val), "\n\n")
      }
    }
  }
}
```
